findings.description: The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without an explicit encryption setting may be stored without the bucket enforcing encryption at rest.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. The private ACL does not ensure that stored ledger exports are encrypted at rest.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not protect artifact contents from being stored unencrypted.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects can be uploaded without bucket-enforced encryption at rest.

This uploaded object does not set server-side encryption, and its destination bucket has no default encryption configuration. The vendor roster may therefore be stored without an explicit encryption-at-rest control.
